scope: S14 source saving without preparation plus focused R2/R12 source detour, validation and persistence

native.sourceTypeAX:
- combobox "Source type":
  - option "RSS / Atom" [selected]
  - option "Twitter / X"
  - option "Hacker News"

environment.runtime: Actual current native main/preload/production renderer on tested macOS/Electron installation
environment.server: Owned local large-catalog HTTP fixture; source URLs not fetched
environment.profile: Fresh isolated protected connection profile; hidden window and muted audio
environment.providers: Null key adapter and external networking blocked; fetch counter installed after launch and before exercise

flow: Play ordinary music, open player DJ controls, News bucket Settings, draft mood/interests and Manage sources.
Save Hacker News Best stories; duplicate endpoint retains form and existing source.
Save an X search while provider keys are absent; access/token guidance remains visible.
Reject credential-bearing RSS URL without discarding name; correct URL and save.
Back to setup restores focus/draft, leaves sources unselected; explicitly select RSS and Save setup.
Edit selected RSS URL, return with selection intact, then reopen the native process.
Fresh-process state retains three sources, selected-source reference, updated URL, mood/interests and both opt-ins off; preparation library remains empty.

acceptance.S14: Controlled: creating/editing sources produces no external fetch during the exercise and no preparation request/script/take; no radio opt-in changes.
acceptance.R2/R12: Focused source detour and focus/draft evidence only, not every setup field/keyboard/screen-reader or observed-usability result.

limits: Automatic preparation was off. Existing independently enabled profiles remain governed by their saved opt-in; this does not promise they stop when a source is edited.
No RSS/HN/X live collection, source relevance, actual X entitlement or provider generation quality is established.
Accessible name observed only for source type combobox; no full VoiceOver claim.

checks.productionSourceAndBundle: Unchanged from preceding passing build/TypeScript/full ESLint checks; no redundant build run for evidence-only update.
